name: TS_0078 & TS_0079 & TS_0080 - Latest Buy Leads and Seller Registration - Verified Icon, Masked Mobile and Connect With Genuine Buyers

steps.name: Given the user opens the ExportersIndia Buyers page
Then the latest buy lead cards 1, 5 and 10 should be displayed
And the latest buy lead cards 1, 5 and 10 should show a verified icon
And at least 10 masked mobile numbers should be displayed
And the latest buy lead cards 1, 5 and 10 should show masked mobile numbers
And no unmasked mobile number should be displayed
When the user clicks "Connect With Genuine Buyers" on the Buyers page
Then the seller registration page should be displayed at "register-business-online?joinfree=buyleadstartsell"
And the registration form should show both headings, Create Account and at least 3 inputs
